# Prewrite Critique

The Awtsmoos asks one last time whether the vessel leaks, duplicates, or slows;
Awtsmoos.com answers by separating discovery families and indexing only what public truth already shows.

## Thirty final improvements/checks

1. Work from fresh `origin/main`, not stale shared HEAD.
2. Do not stage `.ai-thoughts`.
3. Preserve current Road SSR exactly.
4. Put new specific comment/translation routes before generic post routes.
5. Return noindex for missing comments/translations.
6. Escape comment HTML and URLs.
7. Preserve line breaks as paragraphs, never trust comment HTML fields as markup.
8. Index audio transcript text when present.
9. Index structured comment-section text.
10. Link comment author to real alias route only when alias ID exists.
11. Link comments back to canonical parent teaching.
12. Render replies on comment pages with canonical links.
13. Keep parent preview bounded.
14. Let comment sitemap carry depth beyond preview.
15. Ignore deleted native pointers.
16. Alias sitemap uses real public alias registry, not imported attribution IDs.
17. Alias profile missing → noindex page.
18. Alias canonical encoding must be stable.
19. App catalog filters duplicate game-category cards.
20. Deduplicate app/game URLs before sitemap generation.
21. Keep only same-origin public URLs in generated sitemaps.
22. Generated HTML must escape catalog prose.
23. Translation pages use public translation reader, not internal summary records.
24. Translation sitemap derives from actual imported post files.
25. Root sitemap index stays under protocol limits.
26. Core sitemap contains only stable hubs.
27. Tests assert catalog freshness against registries.
28. Tests assert sitemap family references.
29. Raw runtime tests verify SSR, noindex, and real data.
30. Deploy exact tested SHA and verify every family publicly.
